types.name: role
types.description: The role assigned to a person under the Halvorsen Lab Equipment Checkout Policy. Every person has exactly one role.

values.description: A person who is an enrolled student.
A person who is a member of staff.
A person who is a visitor.
Any role not captured by the explicitly listed roles. Since the policy states every person has exactly one of the listed roles, this value is not valid.

rules.alternateExpression: A person's role must be one of the defined roles (enrolled student, staff, or visitor); the OTHER value is not valid because every person has exactly one of the listed roles.
If the person's role is visitor, then they may not check out lab equipment.
if mayCheckOutLabEquipment is true, then personRole is equal to enrolled student or personRole is equal to staff
if mayCheckOutLabEquipment is false, then personRole is not equal to enrolled student
if mayCheckOutLabEquipment is false, then personRole is not equal to staff

variables.name: personRole
variables.description: The single role held by the person being evaluated for equipment checkout: enrolled student, staff, or visitor.

variables.name: mayCheckOutLabEquipment
variables.description: Whether the person is permitted to check out lab equipment under this policy.
